## Summary

The `sglang-miles` port of #44603 (the same 15 commits) on the `sglang-miles` bump to sglang `v0.5.22`; it supersedes #44239. The one difference from #44603: `sglang-miles` keeps its trajectory semantics from #40786 (timesteps cover every step, latents follow `rollout_return_step_indices`, `latent_step_indices` is recorded), which miles-diffusion depends on.

Rollout stops being a scheduler / denoising-stage mixin: each latent stream of a rollout request gets a `FlowRolloutController` whose `transition` the loop passes into `scheduler.step`. Serving is untouched; rollout numerics do not change.

It supersedes the design in #37940; @niehen6174 is co-author on the derived commits. @JingwenGu0829 found the issues fixed in commits 13 and 14 (Rockdu/sglang#4) and is co-author on commits 13 to 15.

## How it works

- `FlowMatchEulerDiscreteScheduler.step(..., transition=None)` runs `transition or self._transition`. Loops pass `**rollout_step_kwargs(batch)`, which is empty for serving requests, so every scheduler keeps its serving call.
- Hooks in `rollout_hooks.py`: `prepare_rollout_if_enabled` (before the SP shard), `init_rollout_env_if_enabled`, `rollout_step_kwargs`, `finalize_rollout_if_enabled`; all no-ops for serving.
- Wired into generic `DenoisingStage`, Cosmos3 and LTX-2. A loop without a scheduler (MiniMax H3, next PR) passes its own `build_controller` and `ode_transition`.

## Review guide

Commits 2, 3, 4 and 6 are mechanical moves verified by the chain verifier (4/4 proofs) and commit 1 is a pure rename; skim them. Review commits 5, 7 to 11 and 13 to 15.

## Tests

- GPU A/B against #44603 and against the previous `sglang-miles` (#44239): bitwise identical for Qwen-Image, Cosmos3 and LTX-2.3 at SP 1 and 2.
- miles-diffusion full e2e on this tree (radixark/miles_diffusion#315): every suite passes, bitwise equal to its standard. MiniMax H3 GRPO and Qwen-Image GRPO were re-recorded for changes that came with the bump (#38671 + #41906 for H3, #43691 for Qwen-Image), attributed in radixark/miles_diffusion#315.
- Rollout unit tests: 74 passed.

- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
